notablePrerequisites: You control at least three legendary creatures.
description:
Activate Sokenzan's second ability by paying {R} and discarding it.
Turntimber Sower triggers, creating two 0/1 Plant creature tokens.
Resolve the Sokenzan ability, creating four 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two creatures, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Turntimber Sower by paying {G} and sacrificing three creatures, returning Sokenzan from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
